recent.text: The Hawks ended up with 14 more shooting possessions than the Nets. And they needed them all.

recent.quoted_text: Not the prettiest win for the Hawks tonight against Brooklyn, but still a win. Atlanta erases a 17-point deficit and uses a 10-0 late run to seal a 4th straight victory. 30-7-6 for Jalen Johnson in his return. 9 pts, 10 reb, 7 ast, 6 stl for Daniels. @LockedOnHawks to come.
